name: InitializeInterruptsAndDefaultHandlers
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Initialize interrupt vectors, default handler pointers, DISPSTAT/IME, and a small amount of global interrupt state. This is the common low-level startup/interrupt init path.

name: ResetHardwareAndMemory
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Reset GBA hardware-facing memory regions and initialize default video/palette state. Clears VRAM/IWRAM-facing state and prepares the system for the main loop.

name: ClearOamAndVramShadow
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Clear OAM and the engine's VRAM shadow buffers to a default empty state. Used during low-level video reset/init.

name: NoOpActionHandler
comment: Simon/Rokusho: First-stage action-family placeholder. In the ActionId dispatch table, many actions map here, meaning this specific phase does nothing for them and their real behavior is implemented in later shared state machines, generic attack resolution, or other action-sequence tables.

name: BuildShadowOamFromObjectState
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Build shadow OAM from the engine's object state table. Scans active object entries, transforms them according to object mode/affine/visibility flags, emits OAM entries, and clears the unused tail of shadow OAM.

name: SetObjectAffineMatrixFromAngleAndScale
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Compute and write an object's affine matrix entries from angle and scale inputs. Handles both fixed default-scale and externally supplied scale sources.

name: SetObjectScaleVectorFromMode
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Set one object's scale vector entries according to the current object transform mode and scale source. Writes the two scale components used by affine OAM objects.

name: RotateObjectOffsetByAffineAngle
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Rotate an (x,y) object offset vector using the affine angle stored in the object state record.

name: SortActiveObjectIndicesByPriority
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Sort the temporary active-object index list by the secondary priority byte stored in each 4-byte entry. Used before building shadow OAM.

name: InitializeLinkTransferState
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Initialize the serial/link transfer state machine, clear its ring buffers, set up the packet queues, and enable the serial interrupt.

name: UpdateLinkTransferState
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Advance the serial/link transfer state machine. Handles handshake state, starts timed transfers when appropriate, and returns a packed status bitfield describing the current link state.

name: QueueLinkTransferPacket
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Queue one outbound serial/link packet into the current transmit buffer, including header/checksum fields, and mark the packet as pending for transmission.

name: MainState0
comment: estado 0 (soft reset volta para ca)

name: InitializeBattleStatusScreen
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Initialize the battle status/details screen state machine. Sets up BG layers, decompresses status-screen graphics/tilemaps, loads palettes, initializes the relevant screen widgets, and advances the current game subroutine state.

name: InitializeBattleSceneScreen
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Initialize the main battle scene screen. Configures BG layers, decompresses battle scene graphics/tilemaps, loads composite battle sprite resources, builds the sprite objects, initializes supporting scene widgets, and advances the current game subroutine state.

name: FightPreview_CachePlayerLoadoutForScene
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Cache the current player-side preview loadout into fight_information.preview_loadout_cache. For each of the three player preview bots, store the leg icon index plus the four part ids used later by the preview/battle-intro scene.

name: LoadBattlePreviewSpriteTilesForAllSlots
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Load composite preview sprite tile graphics for every active battle/menu preview slot. Each active slot contributes one four-part Medabot preview sprite.

name: BuildBattlePreviewSpriteObjectsForAllSlots
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Build the composite preview sprite OAM objects for every battle/menu preview slot. Inactive slots are masked out; active slots get a 4-object composite sprite.

name: DrawBattlePreviewPartIcons
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Draw the part icon tile blocks for every battle/menu preview slot. Uses the legs/part-set preview id when valid, otherwise draws the placeholder icon.

name: DrawBattlePreviewMedalLabel
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Draw the medal label for the currently selected battle preview entry. Uses a generic placeholder label for some entry types and otherwise renders the actual medal text.

name: DrawBattlePreviewNameLabel
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Draw the name label for the currently selected battle preview entry. Uses a placeholder string for generic entries and otherwise copies the actual name text before rendering it as OAM text.

name: DrawBattlePreviewPortraitTileBlock
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Draw the portrait/face tile block for the currently selected battle preview entry. Loads either the placeholder portrait tiles or the actual portrait tiles and stamps the 2x2 tile block into the BG tilemap.

name: InitializeBattlePreviewPortraitRenderer
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Initialize the software/auxiliary portrait renderer used by the battle preview screen. Clears the working buffers, initializes the renderer state, and draws the first preview portrait frame for the selected entry.

name: RenderBattlePreviewPortraitFrame
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Battle preview small portrait uses the same side split as the large portrait caller: side flag at menu state +0x5E selects param_12 0/1 and changes the destination cached OAM span buffer offset, while the CompositePreviewContext still points at 0x02026000/0x020260D0.

name: RenderBattlePreviewLargePortraitFrame
comment: Simon/Rokusho: RenderBattlePreviewLargePortraitFrame calls BuildFourPartLargePreviewComposite(..., param_10=8, mode=5, side=0/1). Because param_10 low bit is 0, this large-portrait path does not request the appearance-row variant increment used by LoadCompositePreviewDescriptorRecursive.

name: HandleBattleMenuDirectionalInput
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Handle directional input in the battle menu/status UI. Updates the current selection through a small transition table, plays the cursor sound, and refreshes the dependent UI widgets when the selection changes.

name: InitializeBattlePreviewComparisonSprites
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Initialize the small comparison/overlay composite sprites used by the battle preview toggle state. Clears four sprite slots and prepares them through the shared preview-sprite setup helper.

name: UpdateBattlePreviewComparisonSpriteSlot
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Update one comparison/overlay preview sprite slot by recomputing its position, frame selection, and affine state from the current preview-toggle selection.

name: RefreshBattlePreviewComparisonSprites
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Refresh the four comparison/overlay preview sprite slots. Either hides them when preview compare mode is off or updates their visible state and per-slot animation when compare mode is active.

name: HandleBattlePartPreviewToggle
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Handle the button press that toggles the part-preview/compare state in the battle menu. Swaps preview data when needed, rebuilds the dependent widgets, and refreshes the preview sprite.

name: RefreshBattlePartPreviewSprite
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Refresh the currently selected battle part preview sprite. Validates the selected part-id set and enables animation on the corresponding composite sprite if the ids are valid.

name: PartDetail_UpdateHeadAttributeMatchMarker
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Update the head-part UI marker based on whether the selected head part's RomPartRecord.attribute_id matches the currently selected medal's required/compatible attribute.

name: PartDetail_UpdateLegsAttributeMatchMarker
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Update the legs-part UI marker based on whether the selected legs part's RomPartRecord.attribute_id matches the currently selected medal's required/compatible attribute.

name: PartDetailScreen_Init
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Initialize the part detail/equip preview screen. Copies the selected RomPartRecord into scratch, then draws the part name, part Attribute name, description, slot-specific stat labels, stat values, and filter state for cycling through owned replacement parts.

name: PartSetPreview_DrawAttributeMatchMarkers
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Draw per-slot attribute match markers for the four parts in the selected part set. The marker is controlled by RomPartRecord.attribute_id.

name: PartDetail_GetCurrentSelectionLegIconIndex
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: PartDetail_DrawCurrentSelectionPartName
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: PartDetail_DrawCurrentSelectionAttributeName
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Draw the current part's Attribute name by indexing gPartAttributeNamePointerTable with RomPartRecord.attribute_id, copying the custom-encoded glyph stream, then rendering it through BuildObjectTextFromGlyphStream. Confirmed decoded attribute strings in the English Rokusho ROM include Grapple, Shoot, Optic, Bomb, Gravity, Formation, Movement, Stop, Bind, Flow, Release, Cancel, Defense, Heal, Revive, Anti-Air, Anti-Sea, Scout, Conceal, Time, Interrupt, Destroy, Regenerate, Teamwork, Counterattack, Transform, and Nothing.

name: PartDetail_DrawCurrentSelectionDescription
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Draw the current part description text from the part-description pointer table. Separate from RomPartRecord: the description is not stored inline in the 16-byte raw part record.

name: PartDetail_DrawCurrentSelectionGenderBadge
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Draw the current part's gender/female compatibility badge using the copied RomPartRecord.gender byte.

name: PartDetail_DrawStatLabelsForSlot
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Draw the stat label set for the currently selected slot. Head, arm, and legs parts use different label templates because the same raw RomPartRecord bytes map to different gameplay meanings by slot.

name: PartDetail_DrawCurrentSelectionStats
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Draw the numeric part stats for the currently selected part. This screen uses the copied RomPartRecord bytes at +0xEE and renders offsets +4..+9 as the slot-specific stat list: armor, ROS/propulsion, power/evasion, chain-or-defense, uses-or-proximity, and charge-or-remoteness.

name: PartDetail_CountAvailablePartsForCurrentAttributeFilter
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Count parts available to the current part-detail menu state, with an optional filter that checks RomPartRecord.attribute_id against the currently selected medal/attribute filter.

name: PartDetail_HandleSelectionChangeInput
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Overworld_ReloadMapSceneAndAdvanceGameState
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Reload the current map scene for a scripted/game-state transition, refresh map rendering, create the player object sprite, clear the transition latch, and advance the owning game-state subroutine.

name: Fight_HandleRewardGrantOrSkipByPostBattleFlags
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Post-battle reward handler keyed by gPostBattleModeFlags low nibble. Low nibble 0 runs the normal reward grant path; nonzero clears the mode byte and jumps directly to subroutine 0x3E.

name: Fight_SelectTemplateForCurrentEncounter
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Selects the active FightTemplate for the current encounter, copies it into fight_information.template, and if template_flags == 0 rerolls each bot's head/right/left/legs part ids. The bot loop indexes the copied template as raw bytes because the code memcpy's the 0x28-byte template into RAM first; offsets +4..+7 within each 0x0C bot record are the four part ids, not stat_nibbles_packed.

name: Fight_SelectTierPartId
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Chooses one of four part ids by encounter rarity tier using the same random-roll thresholds as encounter battle selection: <0x28 common, <0x46 uncommon, <0x5A rare, else very rare.

name: UpdateSelectedMedabotPreviewScreen
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Selected-Medabot/Medawatch full preview update loop. Refreshes the preview renderer, responds to button state, updates displayed part ids, and redraws both the small and large selected-bot previews for the current cursor position.

name: Fight_InitializePartStates
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Initialize the four live BattlePartState records for each bot. The first 0x0D bytes of each BattlePartState come from the ROM part_information subrecord for head/right/left/legs. Runtime fields are then populated, including current_durability and part_id. The head/right/left/legs part records live at BattleBotStateRecord.parts[0..3].

name: Fight_InitializeBotFromTemplate
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Initialize one enemy-side BattleBotStateRecord from the copied FightTemplate in fight_information. The function copies a RomMedalInfo record into gBattleScratchBuffer, transfers selected medal metadata into BattleBotHeader, copies the head-part ROM record into the live bot state, expands the 4 packed speciality seed bytes from the template into 8 raw speciality levels, then scales those 8 levels through the medal's speciality base table and medal level to produce the final live speciality levels.

name: Fight_SelectActionFromCycleOrPendingOverride
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Select an action source from the current speciality cycle, unless pending effect kind 0x2C forces the fallback priority-list selector path immediately.

name: Fight_TrySelectActionFromSpecialityCycle
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Resolve the current action entry from BattleBotStateRecord.speciality_action_table[current_speciality_cycle_index]. Values 1..3 try the part slots, value 4 falls back to head selection, and values 5..7 try medaforce slots.

name: Fight_SelectFallbackActionFromPriorityList
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Choose a fallback action source when the current speciality-cycle entry cannot be used directly. This scans the 4-byte priority list in fight_information and falls back to Fight_SelectActionSource(bot, 0) when no usable entry exists.

name: Fight_IsPartActionLockedByPendingEffect
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return nonzero when pending effect kind 0x2B targets the requested part slot. This is used by action availability and description UI to show an override/locked state for that slot.

name: Fight_IsHeadActionUnavailable
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_IsPartActionUnavailable
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_SelectActionSource
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Select the current action source for the bot. Values 1..3 target BattlePartState_Clean entries (head/right/left) and copy BattlePartState_Clean.target_bot_id / target_part_id into the bot's selected target fields.

name: Fight_TrySelectMedaforceAction
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Try to select a medaforce action source. This checks battle-state restrictions, medal level thresholds, and optional random medaforce slot choice before committing selection through Fight_SelectMedaforceActionSource.

name: Fight_IsMedaforceSelectionBlockedByBattleState
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_SelectMedaforceActionSource
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Commit a medaforce action source selection. This caches the medal medaforce list, copies the selected medaforce descriptor into battle scratch, and selects action source values 4..6.

name: Fight_IsPartActionAvailable
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return nonzero when a requested part action slot is currently available. This first honors the pending effect that locks a specific part slot, then rejects broken/unusable parts, then runs the shared part-action validation path.

name: Fight_GetDisplayedPartIdsOrBrokenGlyphs
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Build four display bytes for a bot's visible parts. Broken parts use a fallback broken-part glyph derived from BattleBotStateRecord.broken_part_fallback_glyph_index; intact parts use BattlePartState.part_id.

name: Fight_RefreshDisplayedPartSpritesForActiveBots
comment: Simon/Rokusho: For each active bot on both sides, refresh the displayed part sprites so broken parts and broken-head glyphs are reflected in the battle UI after damage, repair, or replacement logic.

name: Fight_ShouldMirrorReactionIndicatorX
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return whether the small reaction indicator should be mirrored on the X axis for this bot slot. The logic is driven by reaction_status_flags bit 0x04 and the bot side.

name: Fight_RefreshBotDisplayedPartSprites
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Rebuild the displayed part sprite set for a single bot using Fight_GetDisplayedPartIdsOrBrokenGlyphs, then place the resulting composite sprite objects at the provided screen coordinates. This is a presentation refresh step used after armor/part state changes.

name: Fight_DrawSelectedActionDescription
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Draw the currently selected action's description text. Uses the selected part's technique and the action metadata bytes to pick text variants or failure text.

name: Fight_DrawSelectedActionStatusText
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Draw the selected action's status/override text. This chooses between generic action description text, support/utility text variants, and the pending-effect override text shown when effect kind 0x2B targets the selected part slot.

name: Fight_IsPartTechniqueSupportUtilityClass
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Check whether a part's technique belongs to the support/utility bucket used by the action description and availability UI. Current confirmed members are CancelOptic, CancelBomb, CancelGrav, Accel_Chrg, and Strengthen.

name: SetSelectedMedabotPreviewPartIds
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Stores the currently selected Medabot's head/right-arm/left-arm/legs part ids into the shared preview state block at +0x98..0x9B before the selected-bot preview renderer consumes them.

name: InitializeSelectedMedabotPreviewRenderer
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Selected Medawatch preview init clears context at 0x02026000, clears template/OAM workspace at 0x020260D0, and seeds CompositePreviewContext as { runtime_state = 0x02024000, descriptor_table = 0x083D1D98, template_table = 0x020260D0 } before calling BuildFourPartLargePreviewComposite.

name: RenderSelectedMedabotPreviewFrame
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Renders one updated selected-Medabot preview frame from the part ids stored at +0x98..0x9B in the shared menu state block. This is the non-battle preview path used by the selection UI.

name: RenderSelectedMedabotLargePreviewFrame
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Renders the larger selected-Medabot full-body preview at anchor (0x44,0x2A) using the same runtime template/OAM path as the smaller selected-Medabot preview.

name: AdvanceSelectedMedabotPreviewAnimationSlot
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: HandleSelectedMedabotPreviewCursorInput
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Cursor handler for the selected-Medabot preview screen. On cursor moves it refreshes displayed part ids, calls SetSelectedMedabotPreviewPartIds, then redraws the selected-bot preview frame via RenderSelectedMedabotPreviewFrame.

name: Fight_IncrementActionUsageCounter
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Increment a per-technique / per-medaforce usage counter for the acting bot's current action source. For part actions, indexes by the selected part's technique_or_leg_type.

name: Fight_ApplyPostBattleMode20PlayerSideState
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Special post-battle mode hook. If gPostBattleModeFlags high nibble is 0x20, seed the three player-side battle state entries with 0x50 before the result flow continues.

name: Fight_PlayBattleResultMusicByPostBattleMode
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Select battle-result music/scene family from gPostBattleModeFlags. High nibble 0x00 uses the default per-battle mapping, 0x10 forces family 0x0C, and 0x20+ falls into family 0x0D.

name: Fight_TickSecondaryEffectTimers
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Tick the secondary long-lived battle effect block on a slower timer. This is separate from pending_effect_kind and currently feeds the repair-over-time style handler at +0xC4..+0xC7.

name: Fight_TickActiveBotStatusEffects
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Tick per-bot active status effects. This advances pending-effect timers/values for each active bot and applies any ongoing per-turn status damage or secondary effect output.

name: Fight_TickSecondaryRepairEffectAndEmitResult
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Advance the secondary repair-style effect block at +0xC4..+0xC7. Effect kind 0x1F repairs damaged parts over time, accumulates the applied total, and emits a result summary back into fight_information.

name: Fight_TickPendingEffectDurationAndEmitResult
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Advance the pending effect timer/value block. Fire/Melt (0x13/0x14) also tick damage across intact parts and emit the applied total back into fight_information, while values below 4 clear the whole pending-effect state.

name: Fight_FindDamagedPartIndex1Based
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return the first part index + 1 whose BattlePartState.current_armor is nonzero and less than BattlePartState.armor. Returns 0 if no repairable part exists.

name: Fight_AddPartArmorClampOverflow
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Add repair/heal value to BattlePartState.current_armor for the selected bot part, clamping to BattlePartState.armor. Returns leftover amount encoded for the caller when the heal overflows past max armor.

name: Fight_FindNextPartWithArmorForPendingEffect
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Find the next part slot with remaining armor for a pending-effect damage application. The search starts from the pending-effect stage/slot when present and wraps through the four part slots.

name: Fight_ApplyPendingEffectDamageToPart
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Apply a pending-effect damage amount to one part slot and return both the applied amount and any leftover amount in the high byte of the packed result.

name: Fight_SubtractActionChargeMeterClampZero
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_AdvanceTargetResolutionIndicatorForBot
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_UpdateTargetResolutionIndicatorAnimation
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_UpdateSecondaryEffectIndicatorObjects
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Update indicator objects for the secondary long-lived effect block. Current confirmed kinds are AutoRecover (0x1F), Boost_Chrg (0x26), and Drain_Chrg (0x29).

name: Fight_DrawReactionSourceIcon
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Render the small reaction-source icon for a bot. Uses reaction_status_flags, reaction_source_part_id, and reaction_source_action_kind to choose the icon and sprite frame.

name: Fight_RefreshReactionIndicatorsForActiveBots
comment: Simon/Rokusho: For each active bot on both sides, refresh the small reaction/status indicator objects using the current bot coordinates. This is a presentation-wide follow-up step after part-state changes and resolution updates.

name: Fight_SetSupportBonusSlotIndicesForCurrentTeam
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Derive support-bonus slot indices for the current acting team. support_bonus_slot_index selects the acting team's support/Scout slot block and mirrored_support_bonus_slot_index selects the opposite block.

name: Fight_ResetBotActionSelectionState
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Reset per-bot action-selection state. Caches the current selected action source part into reaction_source_part_id and seeds reaction_source_action_kind from that part's technique when the source is a normal part action. Also clears per-part target metadata and normalizes reaction-status bits.

name: Fight_CommitStagedPartReplacement
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Commit a previously staged part replacement from fight_information back into the selected live BattlePartState. Restores the staged part fields including attack_damage_scalar and part_id, refreshes action metadata, then clears the staging flag.

name: Fight_ResetBotResolutionAndActionScratch
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Reset one bot's defender-resolution flags and shared action scratch. Clears defender_resolution_flags, clears transient reaction_status_flags bits 0x02/0x08/0x10, and zeroes the shared fight_information action-script / result scratch regions.

name: Fight_SelectRecoveryTargetFromPendingEffect
comment: Simon/Rokusho: When Confusion (pending effect kind 0x2C) is active, choose a new recovery/target part and overwrite the bot's selected target metadata. This is a control-disruption retargeting path, not direct damage math.

name: Fight_UpdateActionSlotAvailabilityState
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Update the three action-slot availability state bytes in fight_information. Each slot is classified as broken/unavailable, support-utility, locked by pending effect kind 0x2B, or normally usable.

name: Fight_CreateTargetResolutionIndicatorObject
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_GainPartProficiencyExperience
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Award speciality experience for the bot's current action category. The 8 speciality experience bytes correspond to Strike, Berserk, Shoot, Aim Shot, Defend, Heal, Support, and Interrupt. On overflow, increment the matching speciality level and sync both blocks back into medal state.

name: Fight_SyncBotProficienciesToMedalState
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_HandleRangeMismatchFailure
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Handle action failure when the current selected part's speciality class mismatches the required range class from fight_information. Distinguishes proximity-class (Strike/Berserk/Defend/Heal) from remoteness-class (Shoot/Aim Shot/Support/Interrupt).

name: ActionFamily_SwordHammer_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Shared action-family entry for Sword and Hammer. If the referenced selected-action source part is already broken, write result code 0x05 and continue the action state. Otherwise mark the current substep complete immediately.

name: ActionFamily_ImmediateAdvance_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: ActionFamily_Press_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Action-family entry for Press. If the currently targeted defender part is already broken, write result code 0x0C and continue the action state. Otherwise mark the substep complete and defer to later resolution logic.

name: ActionFamily_AttackClear_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: ActionFamily_HoldHandler
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: ActionFamily_FireHandler
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_FindAllyFollowupActionSource
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Search the acting bot's allied side for a valid chained/follow-up action source. Records a 1-based source bot slot in fight_information[0xDE] and the source bot's pending action/effect kind in fight_information[0xDF], then either advances the action sequence or marks the step complete.

name: ActionFamily_CancelGravHandler
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_PrepareFollowupSourceDisplay
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Prepare the chained/follow-up source bot for display. Copies the source bot's live battle state into a temporary display area, rebuilds its displayed part ids, and creates the temporary composite sprite used for the follow-up presentation.

name: Fight_AnimateFollowupSourceIntro
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Animate the follow-up source bot's temporary display sprite into view. When the intro completes, seeds the temporary bot state for the follow-up action and advances the action sequence.

name: Fight_AdvanceFollowupSourceApproach
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Advance the temporary follow-up source display toward its next staged position while animating its composite sprite.

name: ActionFamily_Recovery_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Action-family entry for Recovery. Drives a temporary source/target movement or presentation step, then advances into the later follow-up/repair-state pipeline once the animated approach reaches its threshold.

name: ActionFamily_AutoRecover_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Finalize the follow-up source presentation, refresh the displayed parts, reset temporary motion fields, and advance after the source sprite reaches its commit position.

name: ActionFamily_Repair_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Action-family entry for Repair. Waits on a timer-like presentation counter, then creates the temporary repair indicator object and advances into the repair-family resolution pipeline.

name: ActionFamily_Reactivate_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: ActionFamily_AntiAir_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Show the follow-up source part label/text for the currently selected chained-action source, then advance once the text object setup is ready.

name: ActionFamily_Scout_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Commit the chained/follow-up action source into active battle state. Transfers the selected source relationship into the main acting bot state and marks the outer action-sequence step complete.

name: ActionFamily_DrainCharge_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Queue text for the selected part action by copying both action-description text keyed by BattlePartState_Clean.speciality and technique text keyed by BattlePartState_Clean.technique_or_leg_type.

name: ActionFamily_Impair_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: ActionFamily_Sacrifice_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: ActionFamily_TeamAttack_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: ActionFamily_Strengthen_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: ActionFamily_Confusion_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Action-family entry for Confusion in the later sequence table. Advances the preview/side sprite sequence and then marks the current handler step complete.

name: ActionFamily_Counterattack_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Action-family entry for Counterattack in the later sequence table. Loads the dedicated presentation assets, initializes the mirrored side-preview objects and per-side object state, then advances the action state.

name: Fight_AdvanceSequenceFromResultFlags
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Advance the outer action-sequence state machine based on defender_followup_flags and action_result_flow_flags. Successful normal resolution increments action usage and Medaforce charge; affinity-result and follow-up cases branch into dedicated sequence states.

name: ActionFamily_InterruptChange_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: ActionFamily_AttackChange_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Action-family entry for Attack Change. Builds a temporary indicator object and seeds its position from the current preview anchors before advancing the action state.

name: ActionFamily_DefenseChange_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Action-family entry for Defense Change. Waits for a helper-driven condition, then seeds a short delay counter and advances the action state.

name: ActionFamily_InterruptChange_Handler_V2
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: ActionFamily_AttackChange_Handler_V2
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_QueueDefenderHeadBreakIfHeadZero
comment: Simon/Rokusho: If the current defender's head armor is zero, queue that bot in fight_information.part_resolution_scratch.head_break_bot_queue for later head-break consequence handling. Otherwise skip directly to the later post-action state.

name: Fight_AdvanceRepairTickWithStatusRefresh
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Advance one repair tick, refresh the affected bot's status display, and advance the action sequence when the repair amount has been fully consumed.

name: Fight_TryStartRepairFollowup
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Attempt to start a repair-style follow-up action. If the acting bot has the required follow-up flags and the target is valid, choose the repair target part, clamp repair to missing armor, and jump the outer action-sequence state machine to the repair branch.

name: Fight_CommitPendingEffectFromCurrentAction
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Commit the current action's pending-effect payload into the acting bot. The committed pending_effect_kind is the selected part's technique id, so shared status behavior can be mapped directly back to action families such as Bug, Virus, Thunder, Freeze, Fire, Melt, Impair, Confusion, No_Escape, and No_Defense.

name: Fight_ShowActionSourceMarker
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Show a marker object at the current action source position. Used during end-of-action/result presentation to highlight the acting source.

name: Fight_AdvanceMirroredCounterTransition
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Advance the mirrored-counter transition. When defender_followup_flags == 3, start the mirrored counter phase, clear object slot 10, raise action_arg_selector, and advance action_sequence_state; otherwise jump directly to sequence state 6.

name: Fight_AdvanceActionSequenceAnimationStep
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Per-frame action-sequence animation step. Advance a countdown/position accumulator until the local animation reaches state 0x28, then reset action_arg_selector and advance action_sequence_state.

name: Fight_ShowInlineEffectTextForCurrentPart
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Spawn inline effect/result text objects near the currently selected part slot for the current action result.

name: Fight_ForceBreakSelectedPart
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Force the currently selected defender part to break by subtracting 0xFF armor, refreshing battle state, and triggering the defender-side part-break consequence path for head breaks.

name: Fight_ResolveSelectedPartAttackBaseStep
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Selected-part attack entry step. | Flow: | 1. validate chosen part exists and is not broken | 2. compute base ROS via Fight_GetPartProficiencyBase | 3. apply virus/bug ROS penalty | 4. require ROS > 31 after Fight_CheckRosMeetsMinimumThreshold | 5. precompute attack-value scalar via Fight_ScaleAttackValueByPartScalar | 6. increment usage counter and continue action sequence | Failure paths set scripted result codes instead.

name: Fight_SelectRepairTargetPart
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Pick a repair target part for the defender/selected bot and clamp the requested repair amount to the target's missing armor. If no valid repair target exists, just continue the outer action sequence.

name: Fight_ResolveSelectedPartAttackBaseStepIfUsable
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Variant of the selected-part attack base step that first requires the chosen part to be usable/intact. Then computes base ROS, applies virus/bug penalties, enforces the ROS floor, and scales by the part damage scalar before continuing.

name: Fight_SelectBrokenPartDamageTarget
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Choose a broken-or-missing target part to receive overflow damage. Restores the defender's effective leg-derived stats first, then either picks a broken target and clamps the overflow damage to that part's current armor or skips ahead if no valid target exists.

name: Fight_AdvanceRepairTickWithEffects
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Advance one repair tick and spawn the accompanying repair effects/particles. Uses different display/effect paths depending on side orientation before advancing the action sequence.

name: Fight_EnsureMirroredSupportSummaryMatchesCurrentAction
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_AccumulateActionResultStatsByActionSlot
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Accumulate per-action-slot result stats in fight_information. For a new action slot, add full total_ros and (accumulated_damage + attacker reserved_D5 bonus); for a repeated slot, add half total_ros and half (accumulated_damage + attacker reserved_D5 bonus). Also stores a use-count path for one special action class. This appears to drive battle result/stat summaries rather than the live damage formula itself.

name: Fight_EnsureMirroredSupportSummaryMatchesTeamForm
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_EnableStoredReactionSourceFromCurrentPart
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Enable a stored defender reaction source from the current part. Sets reaction_status_flags bit 0x08, caches the current part technique/effect id into reaction_source_action_kind, and stores the current damage scratch as the reaction threshold.

name: Fight_CommitAutoRecoverSecondaryEffect
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Commit the secondary AutoRecover effect (0x1F). This seeds the secondary long-lived effect block from total_ros and accumulated_damage.

name: Fight_CommitDirectRepairToHead
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Commit a direct repair action to the target head slot. Clamps the repair amount, writes the resulting armor value back to the live battle state, marks the part runtime as active, and refreshes dependent battle state.

name: Fight_CommitBoostChargeSecondaryEffect
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Commit the secondary Boost Charge effect (0x26). This seeds the secondary long-lived effect block from total_ros and accumulated_damage.

name: Fight_CommitDrainChargePrimaryAndSecondaryEffects
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Commit the Drain Charge effect (0x29) into both the primary pending-effect block and the secondary long-lived effect block.

name: Fight_ApplyRandomPartReplacementEffect
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Apply the in-battle random part replacement effect to the currently selected bot/part. Saves the old BattlePartState into fight_information staging, selects a replacement part id via Fight_SelectReplacementPartIdByIconFamily, copies the replacement ROM part fields into the live part state, refreshes action metadata, and advances the outer action sequence.

name: Fight_QueueHeadBreakIfDefenderHeadZero
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Queue the current defender in fight_information.part_resolution_scratch.head_break_bot_queue if its head armor has reached zero, then advance the action state machine.

name: Fight_CommitMarkedTargetDamageResults
comment: Simon/Rokusho: For each marked target in fight_information.part_resolution_scratch, subtract the already computed multi_target_applied_amount from the selected part, apply broken-leg stat penalties, and queue a head-break consequence if the selected part was the head and its armor reached zero.

name: Fight_AccumulateTeamFormSupportSummary
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_ApplyRepairAcrossMarkedTargets
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Iterate the allies previously marked in fight_information.part_resolution_scratch and spend the current repair pool across the most damaged repairable parts. current_resolution_amount is reused as the remaining repair pool and multi_target_applied_amounts accumulates the repaired amount per target.

name: Fight_MarkTargetsWithBrokenPartsForDamageOverflow
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Mark each ally in the acting bot's side that is active, still has a living head, and also has at least one broken or missing part. The marks and per-target applied totals are stored in fight_information.part_resolution_scratch for the later overflow-damage pass.

name: Fight_ApplyDamageOverflowAcrossMarkedTargets
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Iterate the allies previously marked in fight_information.part_resolution_scratch and spend the current leftover damage pool across randomly chosen broken/missing parts. Each step updates current_resolution_amount, leftover_resolution_amount, applied_resolution_amount, and the per-target multi_target_applied_amounts entry.

name: Fight_CommitBoostChargeSecondaryEffectToMarkedTargets
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_ApplySelectedPartDamageToMarkedTargets
comment: Simon/Rokusho: For each marked target, choose a target part, apply the scripted/direct damage amount, record the selected part id plus the shared high-bit flag in multi_target_part_selection_flags, store the applied amount in multi_target_applied_amounts, then queue head-break handling if the target head reaches zero armor.

name: ActionFamily_StatusCheckFamily_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho

comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: ActionFamily_HealChange_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Action-family entry for Heal Change. Waits on either a button press or a countdown, clears the temporary object slot when done, and advances the action state.

name: ActionFamily_Change_Handler
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Action-family entry for Change. Waits for either a confirm-button press or a countdown, then clears all active temporary object slots in the tracked range and advances the action state.

name: Fight_BuildPartActionMetadataForAllParts
comment: Simon/Rokusho: For the acting bot, iterate head/right/left parts and run the per-technique setup/validation dispatch for each one. This populates per-part action metadata through Fight_SetPartActionMetadata.

name: Fight_SetupTargetSelectionBySpeciality
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Build target/action metadata for techniques that select an active enemy bot with at least one intact part matching the acting bot's primary speciality bucket.

name: Fight_SetupTargetSelectionRequireStatus64
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Technique-setup family used by Anti-Air-style actions. Prefer targets whose bot byte at +0x91 is 0x64 before weaker fallbacks.

name: Fight_SetupTargetSelectionRequireStatus6A
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Technique-setup family used by Anti-Sea-style actions. Prefer targets whose bot byte at +0x91 is 0x6A before weaker fallbacks.

name: Fight_SetupTargetSelectionRequirePendingEffect
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Build target/action metadata for techniques that prefer enemy bots already carrying a pending effect and lacking technique-0x16 parts, then select a target/part pair and store it through Fight_SetPartActionMetadata.

name: Fight_SetupTargetSelectionRequireDamagedPart
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Technique-setup family used by Recovery-style actions. Prefer targets with damaged parts matching the acting bot's speciality bucket, then choose a damaged part if possible before storing action metadata.

name: Fight_SetupTargetSelectionRequireBrokenPart
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Technique-setup family used by Repair-style actions. Prefer targets with broken/missing parts matching the acting bot's speciality bucket, then choose a broken part if possible before storing action metadata.

name: Fight_SetupTargetSelectionRequireStateBA2
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Technique-setup family likely used by Reactivate-style actions. Prefer targets whose bot byte at +0xBA equals 2, then store target metadata for a same-side action.

name: Fight_SetupTargetSelectionExcludeSelf
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Technique-setup family for a same-side move that explicitly excludes the acting bot from candidate targets, then selects a same-side target and stores action metadata.

name: Fight_SetupTargetSelectionRequireNoTechnique16AndClearPending
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Technique-setup family for a same-side move that requires no technique-0x16 parts and a clear pending-action/effect state (+0xC9).

name: Fight_SetupTargetSelectionRequireUsableHeadAction
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Technique-setup family for a head-action-usable targeting move. Requires the target bot's head-action usability byte (+0x58) and always stores part index 1 (head).

name: Fight_SetupTargetSelectionRequireMedaforceToken
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Technique-setup family for a move that requires the target bot's medaforce/token byte (+0xC1) to be nonzero before storing action metadata.

name: Fight_SetupPartTargetSelectionRequireNoTechnique16AndClearPending
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Technique-setup family for a move that requires no technique-0x16 parts and a clear pending-action/effect state, then selects an intact target part explicitly.

name: Fight_ClearPartActionMetadata
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Clear BattlePartState_Clean.target_bot_id and BattlePartState_Clean.target_part_id for the currently selected bot part.

name: Fight_GetOpponentSideBaseIndex
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return the base bot index of the opposing three-bot side: 3 for player-side actors, 0 for enemy-side actors.

name: Fight_GetAllySideBaseIndex
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return the base bot index of the acting bot's own three-bot side: 0 for player-side actors, 3 for enemy-side actors.

name: Fight_HasActivePartWithSpeciality
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return nonzero if the bot has any intact head/right/left part whose BattlePartState_Clean.speciality matches the requested SpecialityId.

name: Fight_HasAnyCandidateTarget
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return nonzero when the three candidate target slots in fight_information[0x61..0x63] contain at least one nonzero bot id.

name: Fight_PickRandomActiveBotInSide
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Pick a random active bot within a three-bot side, retrying nearby slots if the first random choice is inactive.

name: Fight_PickRandomIntactPart
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Pick a random intact part among head/right/left for the given bot. Skips parts whose current armor is zero.

name: Fight_SetPartActionMetadata
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Write per-part target metadata from fight_information scratch into BattlePartState_Clean.target_bot_id and BattlePartState_Clean.target_part_id for the selected bot part.

name: Fight_PickMostDamagedRepairablePart1Based
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return the 1-based slot id of the most damaged repairable part. Damage is measured as max_armor - current_armor; a zero return means no part is both present and missing armor.

name: Fight_HasNoTechnique16Part
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return 0 if the bot has any intact head/right/left part with technique id 0x16; otherwise return 1.

name: Fight_IsBotMedaforceInactive
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return true when the bot's medaforce / special state at +0xC4 is inactive.

name: Fight_IsBotPendingActionClear
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return true when the bot's pending action/effect kind at +0xC9 is clear.

name: Fight_PickRandomBrokenOrMissingPart1Based
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Pick a random head/right/left/legs slot whose current armor is zero and return it as a 1-based part index. Returns 0 if no broken/missing part is found.

name: Fight_IsHeadActionUsable
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return true when the bot's head action usability byte at +0x58 is nonzero.

name: Fight_IsBotMedaforceTokenActive
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return true when the bot's medaforce/token byte at +0xC1 is nonzero. This is the only specialized action-validation predicate in the technique validation table.

name: Fight_BeginPartActionValidation
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Begin validation for a selected part action. Stores the acting bot and part in fight_information scratch, then dispatches through an action-validator table keyed by BattlePartState_Clean.technique_or_leg_type.

name: Fight_ValidateActionRequiresMedaforceState
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Validation helper for actions that require a specific medal-state slot in fight_information to be nonzero.

name: Fight_ValidateActionRequiresMultipleActiveBots
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Validation helper for actions that require at least two active allied bots.

name: Fight_ValidateReferencedActionBot
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Validate a part action whose BattlePartState_Clean.target_bot_id points at another live bot record. Reject when the referenced record is inactive or invalid.

name: Fight_ValidateReferencedActionBotPendingState
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Validate a part action whose BattlePartState_Clean.target_bot_id points at another live bot record and whose pending-action state must also be clear.

name: Fight_ValidateActionRequiresSpecificMedalState
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Validation helper for actions that require a specific medal-state value, including an exact type/state byte match.

name: Fight_ValidateActionRequiresEnemyPartSpeciality
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Validation helper for actions that require an enemy bot to have an active part with a matching speciality bucket.

name: Fight_ValidateEnemyHasPartWithSpeciality23
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_ValidateAllyHasTechnique4Part
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_RunActionScriptLoop
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Run the action-script interpreter loop. Repeatedly reads opcodes from the current action script, skips high-bit-prefixed control bytes, and dispatches via gActionScriptOpcodeHandlerTable until the current script marks completion.

name: Fight_WaitForActionScriptByteMatch
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_WaitForActionScriptChoiceByteMatch
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_EnsureSelectedActionMetadata
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Ensure the acting bot has selected target metadata. If selected_target_bot_id or selected_target_part_id is zero, populate them through helper routines before continuing the action flow.

name: Fight_CommitSelectedReferencedBotGraphics
comment: Simon/Rokusho: When a referenced target bot id is stored in the acting bot's selected action state, copy that bot's graphics/state blocks into the UI/work area and refresh battle presentation.

name: Fight_ApplySpecialityDamageFlags
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Apply battle-status / damage flags based on the selected part's SpecialityId. Proximity-class specialities set one flag family; remoteness-class specialities set another.

name: Fight_ComputeTotalRosPhase
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Action-script phase: compute total ROS for the current action and store it in fight_information.combat_resolution.total_ros.

name: Fight_ApplyPendingEffectStatusFlags
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Apply pending-effect and speciality-derived defender-resolution flags. No_Escape (0x2E) forces BYPASS_EVASION, No_Defense (0x2F) forces BYPASS_DEFENSE, and Thunder/Freeze (0x0F/0x10) force both. SPECIALITY_FLAG_0/1 are also promoted into those bypass bits.

name: Fight_UpdateActionArgSelectorPhase
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Action-script phase: update the current action argument selector from defender state before later conditional action-script checks.

name: Fight_SeedPreDamageFromTotalRos
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Action-script phase: seed the pre-damage value from total ROS by taking total_ros >> 2 before later damage accumulation and modifiers.

name: Fight_AccumulateBaseDamage
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Accumulate final damage into fight_information.combat_resolution.accumulated_damage (+0xEC). | Formula skeleton: | 1. damage = pre_damage_value (+0xEA) | 2. + selected_part.power_or_evasion | 3. + attacker.flat_damage_bonus | 4. + close-range or long-range attacker bonus based on part.skill_id | 5. + extra half of attacker.effective_charge_or_defense for Berserk skill | 6. + selected_part.power_or_evasion again for Laser/Beam actions | 7. + selected_part.power_or_evasion again if optic/bomb/grav affinity bonus flag bit 0x01 is set | 8. + special action-script additive case for action kind 0x34 | 9. + strengthen damage bonus from active Strengthen parts | 10. - defender flat damage reduction byte at bot +0xD1 | 11. - extra pending-effect reduction when follow-up effect kind 0x1B is active | Result stays in +0xEC before clamp-to-armor/application.

name: Fight_HandleActionScriptOpcode1D
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Action-script opcode 0x1D handler. Uses current damage/ROS scratch and defender threshold data to set a small action-script result code in fight_information.

name: Fight_HandleActionScriptOpcode1C
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Action-script opcode 0x1C handler. Sets a small action-script result code in fight_information when the currently referenced action matches the expected state.

name: Fight_MarkDefenderFollowupFromDamageThreshold
comment: Simon/Rokusho: If the defender has the required status bit and the currently referenced part is still active, compare current damage scratch against the defender threshold and raise defender_followup_flags when the threshold condition is met.

name: Fight_ClearMirroredSupportSummary
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_SelectReactionTargetFromOpponentState
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Choose a target bot/part for reaction-driven targeting. Prefer an opponent that currently advertises a usable reaction source; otherwise fall back to a random active opponent and random target part. Writes selected_target_bot_id and selected_target_part_id.

name: Fight_ReadActionScriptInlineArgs
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Decode the current action-script opcode's inline argument payload into fight_information.action_script_inline_args[0..].

name: Fight_AdvanceActionScriptCursor
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Advance fight_information.action_script_cursor past the current opcode byte and its inline argument payload length. Also clears the action-script repeat/continue byte at +0xAA.

name: do_damage_on_part
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_SubtractPartArmor
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Subtract damage from BattlePartState.current_armor for the selected bot part, clamping at zero.

name: Fight_ApplyBrokenLegStatPenalty
comment: Simon/Rokusho: If the legs are broken (parts[3].current_durability == 0), halve the copied legs-derived effective stats: propulsion, evasion, defense, proximity, and remoteness.

name: Fight_RestoreLegEffectiveStats
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Restore the live copied legs stats from BattlePartState.parts[3]: effective_propulsion_or_success, effective_power_or_evasion, effective_charge_or_defense, effective_proximity_or_uses, and effective_remoteness_or_cooldown. In damage/ROS formulas these act as the defender's/equipped legs propulsion, evasion, defense, proximity, and remoteness values.

name: Fight_QueueHeadBrokenBotForResolution
comment: Simon/Rokusho: If the bot's head armor is zero, queue bot_index + 1 into the first free head_break_bot_queue slot in fight_information.part_resolution_scratch. This defers bot-KO/head-break consequence handling until the current resolution sequence processes the queue.

name: Fight_SelectLowestPriorityTargetBot
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Choose a target bot id and store it into BattleBotStateRecord_Annotated.selected_target_bot_id. Prefers the lowest/highest priority target metric depending on side.

name: Fight_SelectRandomTargetPartForSelectedBot
comment: Simon/Rokusho: For the bot stored in selected_target_bot_id, pick a random target part slot and store it into selected_target_part_id.

name: Fight_CopySelectedTargetToFightInfo
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Copy the acting bot's selected target bot/part ids into fight_information[0x88] and fight_information[0x8B] as zero-based target bot/part indices.

name: Fight_ShowObjectSlot
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_HideObjectSlot
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_UpdateFollowerObjectSlot
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Keep one follower/linked object slot visually attached to another object slot while it remains within the visible range; otherwise hide the follower slot.

name: safe_add
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: safe_subtract
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_GetMedalPartCompatibilityBonus
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Sum the part_compatibility_bonus of all equipped parts whose BattlePartState.medal_compatibility matches the bot's medal class.

name: Fight_GetPartProficiencyBase
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Base ROS term for a selected part. | Formula: | base = part.success_or_propulsion |      + Fight_GetMedalPartCompatibilityBonus(attacker) |      + rand(0..7) |      + attacker.skill_level[part.skill_id] |      + attacker.legs_range_bonus(part.skill_id) | where legs_range_bonus picks effective_proximity_or_uses for close-range skills and effective_remoteness_or_cooldown for ranged skills.

name: Fight_ApplyVirusBugRosPenalty
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Apply the ROS penalty from Bug/Virus pending effects. When pending_effect_kind is Bug (0x0D) or Virus (0x0E), subtract pending_effect_value_1 from total ROS.

name: Fight_GetBaseDefenderRosReduction
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Base defender ROS reduction term. | Formula: | reduction = defender.legs.success_or_propulsion |           + Fight_GetMedalPartCompatibilityBonus(defender) |           + rand(0..7) | This scratch term is then extended by Fight_ApplyEvasionReductionToRos or Fight_ApplyDefenseReductionToRos.

name: Fight_IsAntiAirAgainstAirTarget
comment: Simon/Rokusho: True when the current selected part uses the Anti-Air technique and the defender is in the air movement state.

name: Fight_IsAntiSeaAgainstSeaTarget
comment: Simon/Rokusho: True when the current selected part uses the Anti-Sea technique and the defender is in the sea movement state.

name: Fight_AddStrengthenRosBonus
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_SetSelectedTargetBot
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Set the selected target bot for the acting bot and mirror the result into fight_information.selected_slot_index / active target state.

name: Fight_SetSelectedTargetPart
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Set the selected target part for the acting bot and mirror the result into fight_information.last selected target-part state.

name: Fight_IsOpticClassAction
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return nonzero when the current action should be treated as optic-class. True for Laser/Beam techniques or when BattleBotStateRecord_Clean.optic_bomb_grav_bonus_flags bit 0 is set, and only if the target side has the matching optic marker.

name: Fight_IsBombClassAction
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return nonzero when the current action should be treated as bomb-class. True for Missile/Napalm techniques or when BattleBotStateRecord_Clean.optic_bomb_grav_bonus_flags bit 1 is set, and only if the target side has the matching bomb marker.

name: Fight_IsGravClassAction
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return nonzero when the current action should be treated as grav-class. True for Break/Press techniques or when BattleBotStateRecord_Clean.optic_bomb_grav_bonus_flags bit 2 is set, and only if the target side has the matching grav marker.

name: Fight_TargetHasAction34ReactionAffinity
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Special-case affinity check used by the action-result classification path. Returns true when the defender exposes reaction_state_flags.ACTION34_AFFINITY_GATE and the acting part's action kind is 0x34.

name: Fight_TargetHasOpticAffinity
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return nonzero when the selected action is optic-class and the target bot has the matching optic affinity flag set.

name: Fight_TargetHasBombAffinity
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return nonzero when the selected action is bomb-class and the target bot has the matching bomb affinity flag set.

name: Fight_TargetHasGravAffinity
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Return nonzero when the selected action is grav-class and the target bot has the matching grav affinity flag set.

name: Fight_AddStrengthenDamageBonus
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Add strengthen-style damage bonus from equipped parts with technique id 0x05. Uses BattlePartState.power_or_evasion.

name: Fight_ScaleDamageByPartScalar
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Scale the current damage value by BattlePartState.attack_damage_scalar. This uses the same shared ROM part coefficient seen in attack-value scaling.

name: FightPreview_InitializeSideSprites
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Initializes both fight-preview side sprite groups. Side 0 and side 1 call BuildCompositePreviewSpriteLayerWithOffset with different mode tuples; this is a separate renderer family from the plain battle large portrait caller.

name: FightPreview_UpdateSingleLayerSideSprites
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Single-layer fight-preview update path. Side 1 redraw uses BuildCompositePreviewSpriteLayerWithOffset(..., param10=1, param11=1), which becomes BuildFourPartLargePreviewComposite mode 6 instead of the plain large-portrait mode 5.

name: FightPreview_UpdateDualLayerSideSprites
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Dual-layer fight-preview update path. Side 1 invokes BuildCompositePreviewSpriteLayerWithOffset twice with mode 6 and mode 6/5-style layering semantics, reinforcing that the mirrored side can be rendered through a different BuildFourPartLargePreviewComposite mode than the plain battle portrait path.

name: FightPreview_LoadDisplayedPartIdsForSide
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Load the displayed part ids or broken-part glyph ids for the requested preview side into fight_information. Which bot is sampled depends on preview_orientation_flags and whether a mirrored/follow-up presentation flag is active.

name: FightPreview_ResetSequenceStepFlags
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Reset the left and right preview step-flag bytes in fight_information.preview_sequence_state to 0x29 before beginning a fresh side-preview sequence.

name: FightPreview_AdvanceLeftSideSequenceStep
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: FightPreview_AdvanceRightSideSequenceStep
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_IncrementActionUsageCounter_08036270
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Increment the action usage counter for the currently active action entry in fight_information. Used after a successful action base step.

name: Fight_AddMedaforceChargeFromAction
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Add Medaforce charge/token progress for the acting bot after a successful action. Uses a larger gain when the relevant battle-status bit is set and clamps the total at 0x50.

name: Fight_ClampRepairToMissingArmor
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_RepairPartTick
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_ClampDisplayValue1To99
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_SetPendingActionEffect
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Store a pending status/effect payload in the acting bot runtime. In the shared commit path, pending_effect_kind is just the originating technique id: Bug/Virus/Thunder/Freeze/Wave/Hold/Fire/Melt/Defense/Full_Block/Half_Block/Impair/Confusion/No_Escape/No_Defense.

name: Fight_ResetBotActionRuntimeState
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Reset the transient per-bot action runtime state before or after resolving an action. Clears active/action flags, resets small dispatch state bytes, and zeroes the short scratch blocks near +0xC4 and +0xDC.

name: Fight_SpawnInlineEffectTextObjects
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Spawn a short row of inline effect/status text objects at the given position. Used by battle actions to show compact effect labels or status result markers.

name: Fight_StartMirroredCounterActionPhase
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Begin a mirrored/counter-style action phase using the defender's last action kind. Seeds selected target bot/part from the acting bot, copies that target into fight_information, flips side/layout flags, resets action_result_flags, and recomputes attacker/defender affinity result codes from the mirrored action.

name: does_part_exist_or_is_broken
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_CheckRosMeetsMinimumThreshold
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_ScaleAttackValueByPartScalar
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Scale the current attack value by BattlePartState.attack_damage_scalar. This ROM part byte is shared across many action handlers after base ROS/proficiency calculation. The exact in-game stat name is still unresolved, but the field clearly acts as an action power/scale coefficient rather than a one-off runtime flag.

name: Fight_ClampDamageToCurrentArmor
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Clamp accumulated damage against the target part's current armor. | If damage > current_armor: | - applied_damage_to_part = current_armor   (stored at +0xC8 and +0xCC) | - overflow_damage = damage - current_armor (stored at +0xCA) | Else: | - applied_damage_to_part = damage | - overflow_damage = 0

name: Fight_ClampHeadUsesToRemaining
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Clamp a requested head-part use consumption value to the remaining head uses, and store both the applied amount and overflow remainder in fight_information scratch.

name: Fight_SelectReplacementPartIdByIconFamily
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Select a replacement part id for the given slot using a ROM lookup table keyed by the current displayed icon family. Used by the in-battle random part replacement effect. The chosen part id is later copied through CopyPartRecordToBuffer into the live BattlePartState.

name: Fight_GetActionProficiencyBase
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_FindBotWithReactionSource
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Search a side's three bots for a live bot that currently exposes a usable reaction source. Requires the reaction-status bits (0x08 or 0x10) and a still-intact reaction_source_part_id. Returns 0xFF if none are available.

name: Fight_ClearMultiTargetResolutionScratch
comment: Simon/Rokusho

name: Fight_ClearPrimaryAndSecondaryEffectBlocks
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Clear the primary pending-effect block (+0xC9..+0xCC) and/or the secondary long-lived effect block (+0xC4..+0xC7). param_2 bit 0 clears the primary block; bit 1 clears the secondary block.

name: Fight_ComputeTotalRos
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Compute total ROS / attack strength. This includes a direct Scout/support additive term from fight_information.support_bonus_slots[slot_index * 8 + 0], where slot_index comes from fight_information[0x89]. Scout therefore has a real shared ROS/success bonus in the core formula.

name: Fight_HandleDefenderFollowupFlags
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Post-ROS follow-up handler for the defender. Uses selected target metadata, total ROS scratch, and defender flags to set follow-up state bits and possibly pick a retaliatory target part.

name: Fight_ResolveDefenderRosReductions
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Resolve the defender-side ROS reduction phase. If defender_resolution_flags does not already bypass both evasion and defense, run evasion reduction first and only run defense reduction if evasion did not fully terminate the ROS path. Otherwise fall back to the critical-override check.

name: Fight_TryApplyCriticalRosOverrideByActionKind
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Compute the critical threshold from the current action family. Anti-Air vs air and Anti-Sea vs sea use the current ROS reduction scratch directly; skill_id 3 doubles the threshold, skill_id 0 quadruples it, and all other skills scale it by 8 before calling Fight_TryApplyCriticalRosOverride.

name: Fight_TryApplyCriticalRosOverride
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Critical override helper. | If the critical threshold beats current total_ros: | - clear ROS reduction scratch | - set defender_resolution_flags bits 0x04 | 0x08 | 0x40 (bypass evasion, bypass defense, critical hit) | - preserve resolved_ros = total_ros | Because the defender reduction path is bypassed, head-redirect logic that normally occurs during defense reduction may also be bypassed.

name: Fight_ApplyEvasionReductionToRos
comment: Simon/Rokusho: Apply evasion-side ROS reduction. | Formula: | reduction = Fight_GetBaseDefenderRosReduction(defender) |           + defender.effective_legs_evasion |           - (8 unless defense bypass flag already set) | Then try critical override. name: Overworld_AdvanceFollowerStep
